[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Amalia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] junior naval [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who served as the attendant to a high-ranking officer. After a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] carrying a [[tactical data core]] for Amalia's faction was attacked by [[O'reenian]] forces in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Amalia hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to find the data core. The agents subsequently traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]] and recovered the data core, and afterward Amalia paid them their reward and provided them with the co-ordinates of a military base to which she wanted them to take the core.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />
